TerranautS is a dynamic QuakeWorld 2on2 team comprising the skilled duo {{Player|carapace|flag=se}} and {{Player|andeh|flag=se}}. The team was created in December [[2024]] to participate in the [[Kombat 2on2 5|Kombat 2on2 #5]] tournament with the goal of giving the established teams a good run for their money. The two players have never formally participated in a 2on2 tournament previously.

==Notable moments==
The teams first games played, under the TerranautS tag, took place 2024-12-17. The practise series was played against their rivals [[AeronautS]].

==Motto==
While some teams have their head in the clouds, ground dominance secures the win.

==Trivia==
Accusations regarding plagiarism has been thrown around regarding the team´s name and tag. TerranautS has always denied these accusations, pointing to the right of artistic freedom.
